description: Publish the selected global/local inventory collision layers: accepted current CAD meshes, measured unknown-object OBBs and table cuboids. Reuse compatible resident GPU planners. This does not capture images, run SAM3 or FoundationPose, or integrate TSDF/ESDF in CAD/OBB mode. Global updates all currently observed inventory entities; local updates only the selected entities and preserves valid other layers. Neither means hidden space has been observed. The graph chooses scope and exclusion_state. observation keeps all obstacles for empty-hand viewpoint motion; selected binds the current grasp target. A selected map is not an observation map. Missing or stale required geometry is reported, never repaired by republishing identical data.
